title: Privacy Policy — Kiron
description: Kiron privacy policy — how we collect, use, and protect your data in the Kiron AI workout tracker app.
body:
This Privacy Policy explains how Berkeley Labs LLC ("we," "us," or "our") collects, uses, and protects your information when you use the Kiron mobile application ("App").

1. Information We Collect

We collect the following types of information:

  • Account information: Email address and password when you create an account
  • Profile information: Age, sex, height, weight, and unit preferences you provide during onboarding
  • Workout data: Programs, workout logs, sets, reps, and weights you enter into the App
  • Text you enter for AI features: Workout plans you paste to import, and the answers and notes you give when building a program, which may include details like an injury
  • Usage data: App interactions and crash reports collected via PostHog and Sentry to improve the App
  • Device information: Device type, operating system, and app version

2. Health Data

Kiron can work with Apple Health on iPhone or Health Connect on Android. Each use below is optional and asks for your permission first. You can turn it off at any time in Kiron's Settings, or in Apple Health or Health Connect.

  • Saving your workouts: If you turn on Health sync, Kiron writes your completed workouts, with an estimate of the calories they burned, to Apple Health or Health Connect.
  • Body measurements: Kiron reads your weight, body fat and lean body mass (and your waist, on iPhone) to show your latest reading, how it has changed and a chart on the Body screen. Your weight also helps Kiron suggest starting weights.
  • Workouts from other apps: Kiron reads the workouts other apps saved in the last 10 days to estimate how recovered your muscles are.
  • Heart rate: Kiron reads your heart rate during workouts to estimate how hard each one was, for your recovery and training load.

Kiron reads this data on your phone each time it needs it. It does not keep a copy, does not send it to our servers or to any third party, and never sells it or uses it for advertising. The one exception is a choice you make: if you send workouts to Strava, the heart rate your watch recorded during a workout goes to Strava with that workout, through our server, which does not keep it. The workouts you log in Kiron are stored in your account.

Kiron's use of information received from Health Connect follows Google Play's Health Connect permissions policy, including its Limited Use requirements.

3. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

  • Provide and maintain the App
  • Personalize your experience
  • Process subscription payments via RevenueCat
  • Identify and fix bugs and crashes
  • Improve App features and performance
  • Respond to your support requests

4. Third-Party Services

We use the following third-party services:

  • Firebase (Google): Authentication and database storage
  • RevenueCat: Subscription management and payment processing
  • Anthropic: AI processing for plan import (text or photos) and the program builder (see below)
  • Strava: Only if you connect your Strava account (see below)
  • PostHog: Product analytics, linked to your account and email address
  • Sentry: Crash reporting and error monitoring
  • Brevo: Sending and receiving support email

Each of these services has its own privacy policy governing how they handle data.

AI features. When you import a plan or build a program, the text you enter, or the photo of a plan you choose, is sent to Anthropic, the company that makes Claude, to turn it into a program. Your name and email address are not included, and Anthropic does not use this text to train its AI models. Leave out anything you would rather not share. From version 1.1 of the App, Kiron asks for your agreement before sending anything, and you can withdraw it at any time in Settings. Preset programs do not use AI.

Strava. If you connect your Strava account in Settings, Kiron reads the type, start time, length and average heart rate of your Strava activities from the last 10 days, only to estimate your muscle recovery in the App. That data is shown only to you, is kept on your phone for no more than a few hours, is never stored on our servers, and is never sent to an AI service or used for analytics, so an activity you delete on Strava drops out of Kiron within hours. If you turn on sending, Kiron posts each finished workout to your Strava account with its name, time and sets, and its heart rate if your watch recorded it, using your own Strava privacy setting. Kiron keeps only what it needs to stay connected (Strava's access tokens and your Strava account number) and which of your workouts it has already sent. Disconnect in Settings at any time, or remove Kiron on strava.com: Kiron then deletes all of it straight away. Deleting your Kiron account does the same, and we'll confirm the deletion in writing if you email help@trykiron.com. Strava is a separate company with its own privacy policy, and Strava may collect and use information about how Kiron uses Strava's API.

Shared links. When you share a workout or a gym, Kiron stores a copy of only what you share, its exercises with sets, reps, times and distances, or a gym's equipment, with the name you gave it, so the link can open it. It holds no weights, notes, dates or anything that identifies you. Anyone with the link can open it, and it is deleted after 180 days.

5. Data Sharing

We do not sell your personal data to third parties. We may share data with third-party service providers only as necessary to operate the App, and only under agreements that require them to protect your data.

6. Data Retention

We retain your data for as long as your account is active. You may delete your account at any time from the Settings screen in the App, which will permanently delete all your data from our systems.

7. Security

We use industry-standard security measures including encryption in transit and at rest to protect your data. However, no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

8. Children's Privacy

Kiron is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such information, please contact us immediately.

9. Your Rights

Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

  • Access the personal data we hold about you
  • Request correction of inaccurate data
  • Request deletion of your data
  • Object to or restrict certain processing of your data

To exercise these rights, contact us at help@trykiron.com.

10. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of material changes by updating the date at the top of this page. Continued use of the App after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

11. Contact

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, contact us at help@trykiron.com.
